proposal.hypothesis: Splitting the ascending source traversal into j < i and j > i ranges may remove the per-interaction self-equality test while retaining the original interaction order and arithmetic. The duplicated loop body and additional loop boundary may offset any control-flow savings; no speedup is assumed.

retained: Replace the single loop and per-iteration i == j check with two ascending loops over [0, i) and (i, n), preserving the original interaction evaluation order and arithmetic.
